content.short: Off The Grid is a cyberpunk extraction battle royale developed by Gunzilla Games, featuring NFT assets on Avalanche.
content.description: Off The Grid is a premier cyberpunk extraction battle royale shooter by Gunzilla Games, featuring high-action PvP and a rich narrative campaign. Built on the GUNZ blockchain, an Avalanche subnet, the game brings true digital ownership to mainstream gaming. Players can equip unique "cyberlimbs" with specialized combat abilities, where significant items are minted as NFTs for on-chain trading. Directed by Neill Blomkamp, the title bridges high-fidelity AAA gaming and decentralized technology. The platform leverages Avalanche's speed to ensure a seamless experience where player effort is recognized through rewards.
